title: 'No talks or conversations going on, or scheduled, with Iran' — Trump
text:
'No talks or conversations going on, or scheduled, with Iran' — Trump"

"'Hormuz Strait is open and operating'"

"========="

"Source close to Iranian negotiating team dismisses White House claim"

" In response to the White House's announcement that negotiations with Iran have been suspended indefinitely, an informed source close to the Iranian negotiating team told Fars News Agency that no direct talks between Tehran and Washington were ever actually in progress."

" The source clarified that the discussions in question were held with Oman and pertained exclusively to the exercise of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. The source further noted that all dialogue with the American side had already been halted following Washington's violation of the Islamabad memorandum, and that the recent talks with Omani officials bore no connection whatsoever to the United States.
